title: Rajma
description: Red kidney beans simmered in a thick onion-tomato gravy, the classic weekend pairing for steamed rice — a Punjabi household staple.
steps: Drain the soaked rajma and add to a pressure cooker with the water. Cook for 5-6 whistles, until the beans are completely soft and can be mashed easily between two fingers.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle, then add the onions and sauté until golden brown, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute until the raw smell fades, then add the tomato puree and cook until the oil separates from the masala, 8-10 minutes.
Stir in the turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and salt, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the cooked rajma along with its cooking liquid. Simmer, partially covered, for 15-20 minutes, mashing a few beans against the side of the pan to thicken the gravy.
Stir in the garam masala and simmer for another 5 minutes. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice.
